title: Phase A 4/8: fixture snapshots for none, some, all, few and empty filed, dated from the day of the run
description:
Phase A, step 4. Fixture snapshots for every case, built at test time with dates relative to the day of the run (the rolling seven-day buckets are counted back from the render day, so fixed dates drift into other buckets as the calendar moves).

Files:
1. tests/reference_cases.py (new): `write_reference_case(data_directory: Path, case: str, today: date) -> dict` writes `<data_directory>/home-page/references.json` in the snapshot format of tests/fixtures/_data/home-page/references.json (`generatedAt`, `corpus`, `fields`, `references`), copies tests/fixtures/_data/home-page/threads.json and threads/ beside it, and returns the expected counts the steps assert against (`{"videos": {"unfiled": n, "by_section": {...}}, "findings": {...}}`).
   Records: `key` = first 12 hex of sha256("<case>-<kind>-<n>"); `status` "accepted"; `title` "Case <case> video <n>" / "Case <case> finding <n>"; `url` https://example.org/<case>/<kind>/<n> (videos: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<key>, `medium` "video", `host` "youtube.com"); `actor` "cyclotron"; `acceptedAt` and `arrivedAt` spread over six weeks back from `today` (n-th record: today minus (n * 37) minutes, so every bucket has items); `confidence` from 0.99 down; every 10th record `stars` 4, and one record per case 5 stars accepted 20 days ago (it must sort after all of this week's records); `section` per the case; `summary` one sentence; `rank` assigned in the documented shared order (docs/home-page.md "Ordering": 3-5 stars most first, then unrated by confidence, unscored last, then 1-2 stars; ties newest arrival then key). Also 5 `recommended` records per case (they must never appear on these pages).
   Cases (videos and findings each, same pattern):
   - "none": 200 unfiled.
   - "some": 150 unfiled; "Privacy & Security" 12, "Science" 4, "Agents" 1, "Papyrus" 3 (a section with no page in web/sections.json); History 0.
   - "all": 0 unfiled; "Privacy & Security" 70 (more than one first page of 64, so its own list has chunk files), "Science" 4, "Agents" 1.
   - "few": 2 unfiled; "Science" 3.
   - "empty": no accepted record (the 5 recommended only).
   200 and 150 unfiled exceed 64 + 2 x 48 (first page plus two maximal chunks at pageSize 24), so every stream has at least two chunk files.
2. tools/preview_local.py: `project_fixture_site(output_directory, home_page_data_directory=HOME_PAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY, declares_sections=True)`; the copy step uses the data directory argument. With `declares_sections=False`, after `static_directory_with_fixture_article_section` copies the static directory, write `{"articleCards": 12, "postCards": 12, "videoCards": 6, "findingCards": 3, "sections": []}` to the copy's sections.json and regenerate the copy's pages with `sync_section_pages.write_files(web=<copy>)`. Default behaviour unchanged.
3. tools/sync_section_pages.py: every function that reads WEB, PROJECTION, REGISTRY, TEMPLATE or REFERENCE_TEMPLATE takes `web: Path = WEB` and derives those paths from it; add `write_files(web=WEB)` (the current `__main__` write loop) and accept `--web DIR` on the command line. `--check` behaviour unchanged.
4. tests/projection_support.py: `project_reference_case(case: str, declares_sections: bool = True) -> tuple[Path, dict]`: temp dir, `write_reference_case(temp/"_data", case, datetime.now(UTC).date())`, `project_fixture_site(out, temp/"_data", declares_sections)`, returns the output directory and the expected counts.
5. features/environment.py: `context.reference_cases = {}` keyed by (case, declares_sections); a step helper projects a case on first use and caches it; `after_all` removes every cached output directory.

Acceptance: `python3 -c "from tests.reference_cases import ..."` style unit test tests/test_reference_cases.py checks counts per case, unique keys, ranks 1..N without gaps, and that the 5-star record is older than seven days; projecting the "none" case writes reference-lists/videos/untagged/ with at least two chunk JSON files.
